threads.body: For MCP server tools, the fallback `name = tool.get("name") or tool.get("url") ...` can end up recording the full MCP server URL into `gen_ai.tool.definitions` (via the `name` field). URLs can contain sensitive/internal hostnames and shouldn’t be captured by default here. Prefer defaulting to a constant (or only using an explicit `name` provided by the user) until `ToolDefinition` supports a dedicated URI field.
